# libmspack CAB decoder

Unmodified CAB decoding sources from libmspack 0.11alpha, Stuart Caie.
License: LGPL 2.1, included in COPYING.LIB.

Source: https://www.cabextract.org.uk/libmspack/libmspack-0.11alpha.tar.gz
SHA-256: 70dd1fb2f0aecc36791b71a1e1840e62173079eadaa081192d1c323a0eeea21b

Madeira compiles system.c, cabd.c, mszipd.c, lzxd.c and qtmd.c with its
RuntimeCabinet.c adapter. This source distribution and the Xcode project
permit rebuilding/relinking the app with a modified decoder. The license
and this notice are also included in the application's RuntimeLicenses folder.
